These powerful, spider-like creatures are [[elementalist]]s specializing in [[Fire Magic]]. In [[the Underworld]] they can be found lingering around the monuments of [[Grenth]], defacing them in the name of [[Dhuum]]. They can also be encountered in the [[Gate of Pain]] mission in [[Elona]].

==Notes==
*The abundance of [[area of effect]] spells in their repertoire makes it very dangerous for a [[party]] to stay clumped together while fighting these creatures. They usually begin combat with their [[Meteor Shower]]s, so either move away or [[interrupt]] them.
*Their normal attacks cause [[dark damage]] and thus do not trigger [[Mark of Rodgort]].
*A close group of Terrorweb Dryders will scatter if their health is low and an enemy comes closer than approximately half an aggro circle radius, even in [[normal mode]].
*In the hard mode of the Underworld and Tomb of the Primeval Kings, they have 7 [[health regeneration]] and lower total [[health]].
*This creature has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Terrorweb Dryder|version]].
*This creature is very buggy when approached with a spell protection spell active such as [[Shadow Form]] or [[Obsidian Flesh]]. It will run away, not attack anyone, and spam [[Lava Font]]
